values: 战斗开始时康缇丝会躲入书内持续恢复能量。主动释放时使友军恢复大量生命值并为其伪造特殊身份，使该友军违反校规时不会被康缇丝惩罚，且持续将自身生命值转化为护盾值。

When a battle starts, Contess hides within her rulebook and continuously recovers Energy.
Active. Contess restores a large amount of HP to an ally and grants them Exemption, preventing them from being punished by Contess for rule violations. The ally also continuously converts their own HP into a shield.

被动地，战斗开始时康缇丝藏于校规书内，无法行动、无法被敌人选为目标且每秒固定恢复66点能量，当自身能量恢复至上限、有敌人违反校规或其他友军均被击败时，康缇丝进入战场。
主动释放时，康缇丝选择一名友军使其恢复-666% − 66% ATK的生命值并为其赋予“豁免权”，拥有“豁免权”的友军违反己方康缇丝的校规不会受到处罚，且当生命值比例大于40%时，每秒失去2.5%最大生命值，并将失去量的200%转化为护盾，该护盾至多因此拥有100%最大生命值。处于该护盾保护下的友军提高30%攻击力。
自动战斗时本技能优先选择累计造成伤害最多且未获得过“豁免权”的其他友军释放，若所有友军均已获得“豁免权”，则优先选择最虚弱的友军。

Passive. When a battle starts, Contess hides within her rulebook. While hidden, she cannot move or act, cannot be targeted by enemies, and recovers 66 Energy every second.
She enters the battlefield when her Energy is full, when an enemy violates a rule, or when all other allies are defeated.
Active. Contess restores -666% − 66% ATK HP to a target ally and grants them Exemption.
Exemption: Prevents the target ally from being punished by allied Contess for rule violations. While the ally's HP ratio is above 40%, they lose 2.5% of their max HP every second, converting 200% of the lost amount into a shield. The shield value cannot exceed 100% of the ally's max HP. While this shield is active, the ally's ATK is increased by 30%.
When auto battle is enabled, this skill prioritizes the ally with the highest cumulative damage dealt who has not yet received Exemption. If all allies have already received Exemption, it instead targets the weakest ally.
拥有特殊身份的友军因该技能失去生命值时，对应获得的护盾量比例提升至225%。
When an ally loses HP from Exemption's HP reduction effect, the shield conversion ratio increases to 225% of the lost HP.
拥有特殊身份的友军因该技能失去生命值时，对应获得的护盾量比例提升至250%。
When an ally loses HP from Exemption's HP reduction effect, the shield conversion ratio increases to 250% of the lost HP.
拥有特殊身份的友军因该技能失去生命值时，对应获得的护盾量比例提升至275%。
When an ally loses HP from Exemption's HP reduction effect, the shield conversion ratio increases to 275% of the lost HP.
拥有特殊身份的友军因该技能失去生命值时，对应获得的护盾量比例提升至300%。
When an ally loses HP from Exemption's HP reduction effect, the shield conversion ratio increases to 300% of the lost HP.

康缇丝在场时会惩罚违反校规的角色。
校规【禁止打闹】：当战场中有角色累计损耗一定生命或护盾后，对其累计造成最多伤害的敌对角色视为违反该校规。
主动释放时，为最虚弱的若干友军恢复生命值，并使累计输出最高的若干敌人降低攻击力，持续一定时间。

While Contess is on the battlefield, she disciplines those who violate school rules.
Code of Conduct - Be Civil
When a unit on the battlefield loses a certain amount of HP or shield value, the enemy unit that contributed the most damage to that loss is deemed to have violated this rule.
Active. Contess heals several weakest allies and reduces the ATK of enemies with the highest cumulative damage dealt for a duration.

康缇丝在场时，会惩罚场内违反校规的其他角色，使其失去6.6% + 0.6%最大生命值（不超过100% + 10% ATK）。
校规【禁止打闹】：当战场中有角色累计损耗60%最大生命值或护盾值（不高于其敌对方150%初始队伍攻击力），对其累计造成最多伤害的敌对角色视为违反该校规，每名角色每10秒至多违反5次该校规。若友军损耗生命值或护盾值触发该效果，康缇丝还会额外为该友军恢复200% ATK生命值。挑战首领模式下，该校规仅会每隔10秒认定双方累计输出最高的各1名角色违反校规。
主动释放时，为最虚弱的2名友军恢复-150% − 20% ATK生命值，使累计输出最高的2名敌人降低25%攻击力，持续6秒。

While Contess is on the battlefield, she disciplines those who violate school rules, reducing their HP by 6.6% + 0.6% of their max HP. This HP reduction cannot exceed 100% + 10% ATK.
Code of Conduct - Be Civil
When a unit on the battlefield loses 60% max HP or shield value in total (the lost amount cannot exceed 150% of the initial Team ATK), the enemy unit that contributed the most damage to that loss is deemed in violation of this rule. Each unit may violate this rule 5 times within 10s.
If the unit violating this rule is an ally, Contess also heals the allied unit for 200% ATK HP in addition to the punishment.
In Boss battles, this rule is enforced differently: Every 10s, the unit with the highest cumulative damage dealt on each side is considered in violation of this rule.
Active. Contess restores -150% − 20% ATK HP to the 2 weakest allies, and reduces the ATK of the 2 enemies with the highest cumulative damage dealt by 25% for 6s.
主动释放时为友军提供的恢复量提高至-180% − 20% ATK。
Increases the healing amount for allies to -180% − 20% ATK when the skill is actively used.
主动释放时为友军提供的恢复量提高至-210% − 20% ATK。
Increases the healing amount for allies to -210% − 20% ATK when the skill is actively used.
主动释放时为友军提供的恢复量提高至-240% − 20% ATK。
Increases the healing amount for allies to -240% − 20% ATK when the skill is actively used.

校规【禁止喧哗】：战场中释放终极技能的角色视为违反该校规。
主动释放时，为累计释放终极技能次数最多的若干敌人降低回能效率，持续一定时间。

Code of Conduct - Be Quiet
Whenever a unit casts their Ultimate, that unit is deemed in violation of this rule.
Active. Contess reduces the Energy recovery efficiency of several enemies who have cast the most Ultimates. This effect lasts for a set duration.

校规【禁止喧哗】：战场中的角色释放终极技能视为违反该校规，每名角色每6秒至多违反一次该校规。
主动释放时，使累计释放终极技能次数最多的2名敌人降低14% + 2%回能效率持续6秒。

Code of Conduct - Be Quiet
Whenever a unit casts their Ultimate, that unit is deemed in violation of this rule. A unit may only violate this rule once every 6s.
Active. Contess reduces Energy recovery efficiency by 14% + 2% for the 2 enemies who have cast the most Ultimates. This effect lasts 6s.
回能效率降低的效果提高至16% + 2%。
Reduces enemies' Energy recovery efficiency by 16% + 2%.
回能效率降低的效果提高至18% + 2%。
Reduces enemies' Energy recovery efficiency by 18% + 2%.
回能效率降低的效果提高至20% + 2%。
Reduces enemies' Energy recovery efficiency by 20% + 2%.
敌人违反校规时永久降低攻击力和回能效率。
When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK and Energy recovery efficiency.
敌人违反校规时永久降低2%攻击力和1%回能效率，至多因此降低10%攻击力和5%回能效率。

When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK by 2% and Energy recovery efficiency by 1%. The reductions from this effect cannot exceed 10% for ATK and 5% for Energy recovery efficiency.
敌人违反校规时永久降低3%攻击力和2%回能效率，至多因此降低15%攻击力和10%回能效率。

When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK by 3% and Energy recovery efficiency by 2%. The reductions from this effect cannot exceed 15% for ATK and 10% for Energy recovery efficiency.
敌人违反校规时永久降低4%攻击力和3%回能效率，至多因此降低20%攻击力和15%回能效率。

When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK by 4% and Energy recovery efficiency by 3%. The reductions from this effect cannot exceed 20% for ATK and 15% for Energy recovery efficiency.
违反校规被惩罚一定次数的角色会被剥夺学生身份，永久进入无视霸体的沉默状态，并且受到的生命损耗提高。
Contess expels a unit when they're punished a set number of times. Expelled units are permanently silenced, even if they are unaffected, and take increased HP loss.
因违反校规被康缇丝惩罚超过6次的角色，会被康缇丝永久开除，使其遭受学院规则的重压，永久进入无视霸体的沉默状态（对首领敌人无效），且受到的生命损耗提高18%。拥有己方康缇丝终极技能赋予“豁免权”的角色，不受康缇丝该技能效果的影响。

Contess permanently expels a unit when they're punished more than 6 times. Expelled units are permanently silenced, even if they are unaffected (ineffective against Bosses), and take 18% more HP loss. Allies granted Exemption by Contess are not affected by this effect.
受到的生命损耗提高效果提升至20%。
Expelled units take 20% more HP loss.
受到的生命损耗提高效果提升至22%。
Expelled units take 22% more HP loss.
被永久开除的敌人还会每秒失去30% ATK生命值，失去量的40%转化为康缇丝和拥有“豁免权”友军的治疗。
Permanently expelled enemies lose 30% ATK HP per second, and 40% of the HP lost this way is converted into healing for Contess and her allies with Exemption.
违反校规的敌人会受到额外惩罚
Contess punishes enemies who violate a school rule with an extra effect.
非首领模式下，违反校规【禁止打闹】的敌人额外被眩晕2秒，违反校规【禁止喧哗】的敌人额外被沉默6秒；首领模式下，敌人违反校规会被额外惩罚一次。

In regular battles, Contess stuns enemies who violate Code of Conduct - Be Civil for 2s, and silences enemies who violate Code of Conduct - Be Quiet for 6s.
In Boss battles, Contess punishes enemies who violate a school rule one extra time.
